modalities.evidence: heart rate, blood pressure, and respiratory parameters

output.population: 69 diabetic and control participants aged 55 to 75 years at baseline, with 41 subjects completing two years of follow-up
output.summary: Prospective observational study of cerebral vasoregulation and perfusion in type 2 diabetes, combining transcranial Doppler, structural and perfusion MRI, diffusion imaging, cardiorespiratory monitoring, balance and walking, laboratory and retinopathy measures.
